string-array.name: help_bodies
string-array.item: Tap New ▲ to start untitled.txt. If text exists, confirm before replacing it. Your saved file is not deleted.
Hold New ▲ and choose New Markdown file (.md). A blank untitled.md opens in source editing mode, ready to write.
Tap Open and choose a .txt, .md, or .markdown file through Android’s file picker.
Choose a supported text file in your Android file manager and open it with Hermes Text Editor.
Tap to place the cursor, type, select, copy and paste. Long filenames stay on one line; swipe the name sideways to read it.
In Edit Markdown, headings, emphasis, links, lists, quotes and code are styled as you type. All Markdown symbols remain visible and editable; source text is preserved.

Use the three-dot menu to switch modes. Preview is formatted for reading; Edit Markdown shows the original source. Switching keeps approximately the same document section. Tap a web link in Preview to open your browser.
Tap Save ▲ to write the current file. A short message confirms success. If saving fails, your draft remains intact; use Save as… to make a copy.
Hold anywhere on Save ▲ to open Save as… and Export as plain text… above the controls.
Choose Save as… and select .txt or .md, then a filename and folder. The copy keeps the exact source content, including Markdown symbols.
Hold Save ▲ and choose Export as plain text… for a readable .txt copy without Markdown formatting. The original Markdown file is unchanged.
Use the curved icons near the top of the editor. Rapid typing is grouped; unavailable actions are disabled. History is bounded and local. Undo and Redo do not change the saved file until Save.

Choose Find in the three-dot menu. Type a word or phrase and use the previous/next icons. The counter shows current / total matches. Find does not edit text. In Markdown Preview it switches to source mode. Close Find to restore the Undo/Redo control.
Pinch with two fingers to enlarge or reduce text. Zoom applies to editing and Preview, stays between comfortable limits and is saved locally. One finger still scrolls and selects normally.
Use the sun/moon item in the three-dot menu to switch themes. Document styling updates with the theme.
Choose English or فارسی in the three-dot menu. The interface language is saved locally; your document text is not translated.

Choose Left-to-right or Right-to-left in the three-dot menu. Clearly Persian or English files may receive a suggestion when their direction differs from the current setting. Manual direction remains your choice.

Hermes Text Editor works offline: no ads, analytics, tracking, WebView or Internet permission. Your draft is recovered locally. Files are accessed through Android’s picker or file-manager opening. Links open externally only when tapped.
